steps.what: Direct prevention programs and resolve priorities with professional teams

tasks.design: Retain specialty programme leadership and professional discussion. Existing programme information in {PROJECT} supports the physician's decisions; no automatic resource allocation or prevention-policy decision is proposed.
tasks.previous_blocker: Programme management requires weighing risks and stakeholder constraints.
tasks.enabler_now: Information tools do not establish less clinical leadership time.
tasks.still_hard: Uncertain evidence, differing exposures and resource limits require judgement.
tasks.human_edge: The physician balances prevention benefit, feasibility and unintended effects.
tasks.altitude: Programme authority and time remain unchanged.

reach.task: Clarify operational constraints in prevention delivery

evidence.claim: Keeping specialty prevention leadership human is an E1 model-knowledge assessment.

assumptions: Boundary is physician leadership, excluding separate data analysis or clinical history production.
No free structured programme-risk score or machine action is assumed.
Existing project facilities remain; no custom system is proposed.
Zero upkeep because no workflow changes.
research_questions: Which programme decisions require direct professional negotiation?

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B100 R100 gross0 net0. Leadership retains all time; no hypothetical report-writing baseline is removed.

tasks.short: Document and review occupational or environmental histories

steps.what: Review patient history and clarify occupational or environmental exposure details
Document the checked history in the clinical record

loop.purpose: Draft the history note from checked source observations
loop.input: Physician-provided history with dates, exposures, attribution and uncertainty
loop.output: Narrative draft separating reported facts from verified information
loop.check: Physician checks chronology, exposure duration, negation and uncertainty against source observations; no inferred causal diagnosis
loop.stop: One draft; ambiguous provenance or unsupported claims return to manual documentation
loop.why_not_simpler: Test native dictation first; varied narratives may still need bounded drafting into note sections

steps.what: Check history accuracy and finalise the clinical note

tasks.design: Keep history-taking and exposure clarification with the physician, then draft the checked narrative in the clinical record system {OTHER}. The physician verifies attribution and chronology before filing; the model does not establish exposure or causation.
tasks.previous_blocker: Occupational and environmental histories contain long, uneven narratives.
tasks.enabler_now: Bounded note drafting can shorten wording without removing source clarification.
tasks.still_hard: Reported exposure and confirmed exposure must not be conflated.
tasks.human_edge: The physician recognises gaps and distinguishes plausible links from established facts.
tasks.altitude: Less note composition, with exposure assessment unchanged.

reach.task: Clarify provenance of exposure history during handoff

evidence.claim: Autoscriber drafts clinical consultation records for clinician validation; this supports note-drafting capability, not validated occupational-exposure interpretation.
The history adaptation and labour estimate are E1 model knowledge.

assumptions: Boundary is history review, clarification and documentation, excluding causal diagnosis or epidemiological investigation.

The physician supplies patient/encounter ID, source attribution, occupation, exposure narrative, dates, duration and uncertainty in s1. All 40 hours remain, including capture or dictation. Missing details require manual clarification; no automatic extraction establishes facts.
Test native dictation and templates before custom drafting; no ambient recording is required.
Allow five focal hours for template and failure upkeep beyond routine validation.
research_questions: Does drafting preserve source attribution and chronology while reducing total documentation time?

already_counted.description: History clarification and final clinical check

approvals.approved_version: Exact history note, patient identity and source-observation snapshot; changes void approval

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B100 R80 gross20 minus5 upkeep =15 net. High assumes manual narrative entry; low covers already-efficient dictation or substantial rewriting. Source clarification remains unchanged.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Identify population groups needing prevention attention

steps.what: Define the prevention question and check population data and grouping fields
Tabulate disease or injury counts and denominators by specified groups
Interpret group patterns and identify where prevention assessment is warranted

tasks.design: Configure reproducible group counts and explicit denominator calculations in {SPREADSHEET}. The physician checks the input population and interprets patterns; the workbook does not assign an individual clinical risk label or eligibility decision.
tasks.previous_blocker: Repeated group tabulation can distract from assessment of data quality and meaning.
tasks.enabler_now: Native pivot tables and fixed formulas can repeat specified arithmetic.
tasks.still_hard: Selection bias, unstable denominators and confounding can produce misleading patterns.
tasks.human_edge: The physician decides what the pattern supports and what further assessment is needed.
tasks.altitude: Less repeated arithmetic; prevention conclusions remain professional judgements.

reach.task: Explain denominator and grouping choices for review

evidence.claim: Reproducible group tabulation with human interpretation is an E1 model-knowledge design, not a validated automated risk-identification product in the digest.

assumptions: Boundary is population-level grouping and interpretation, not data collection from patients, diagnosis or service eligibility.

In s1 the physician checks and produces record identifier, observation period, group field, event indicator, denominator inclusion and missing-data reason, and specifies filters and formula version. All 50 hours remain for capture, validation and manual clarification; unstructured or unverified records require manual analysis and earn no automatic saving.
Source records are existing inputs from their current clinical or registry producers; no new analyst curation is transferred. New coding work would need re-estimation before adoption.
Test native workbook functions first; allow five focal hours for formula upkeep and exceptional-data reconciliation.
unknowns: Available population fields and denominator quality
research_questions: Do repeated tabulations reconcile to independently checked counts and preserve missing-data visibility?

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B100 R75 gross25 minus5 upkeep =20 net. High needs a repeatable already-verified dataset after counted s1 preparation; low covers manual source reconstruction. No risk-judgement time is removed.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Define the epidemiological investigation and evaluate sources and case definitions
Perform investigations and interpret disease patterns with the investigation team

tasks.design: Retain investigation design, enquiry and interpretation with the physician and investigation team. Existing evidence in {DOCS} supports the work; the broad task does not establish a specific clerical sequence that can be removed.
tasks.previous_blocker: Investigations differ in evidence, urgency and feasible study design.
tasks.enabler_now: General drafting does not establish valid causal inference or substitute for enquiry.
tasks.still_hard: Incomplete observations, bias and alternative explanations need scientific judgement.
tasks.human_edge: The physician challenges assumptions and recognises when conclusions exceed the evidence.

reach.task: Challenge clinical assumptions in a case definition

evidence.claim: Keeping study-specific epidemiological investigation human is an E1 assessment from model knowledge.

assumptions: Boundary is the physician's scientific investigation work; a particular study's data processing needs separate decomposition.
Investigation-team members produce study observations through existing enquiry under the approach; their unchanged fieldwork is outside the focal baseline and no new transfer is claimed.
No free structured case classification or automated causal conclusion is presumed. No custom system is proposed.
Zero upkeep because the workflow does not change.
unknowns: Investigation types, data access and team responsibilities
research_questions: Which repeated administrative operations occur in a concrete investigation without duplicating the separate group-tabulation task?

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B100 R100 gross0 net0. Scientific investigation retains time; population tabulation savings are not claimed twice.

role.ambitious_version: A preventive physician who makes evidence and uncertainty traceable before drawing conclusions about groups or exposures.
